chain_words.nuance: direct to the point of rudeness
honest and open, even when unwelcome
showing great respect and willingness to yield to others

explanation: These words all relate to courtesy in speech and behaviour, moving from directness that can seem impolite to deep, respectful deference.

usage_notes.difference: 'Courteous' describes correct, polite behaviour; 'gracious' adds warmth and generosity beyond what is required.
